name: caldav-mcp
description: Read and manage iCloud Calendar events, including multiple reminders per event.
long_description:
Connects one iCloud account through CalDAV so the assistant can list calendars, find events, and create, update, or delete events and recurring series.

- Multiple reminders (VALARM) per event, using the Apple alarm extensions iCloud expects.
- Partial updates preserve unknown iCalendar data, time zones, recurrence exceptions, and alarms.
- ETag checks prevent overwriting concurrent changes.
- No telemetry and no database: calendar data stays between your machine and iCloud.

Requires an Apple app-specific password (https://support.apple.com/en-us/102654), not your Apple Account password. This independent project is not affiliated with Apple Inc.
